paper.title: LLMSched: Uncertainty-Aware Workload Scheduling for Compound LLM Applications

faithful: completed-stage duration evidence updates the posterior
duration ordering across sets, uncertainty ordering within a set
one epsilon coin per decision selecting EXPLORE or EXPLOIT
adapted: train-only causal-order and lag-constrained structure learning
model-side whole-job unresolved-work estimator with a conservative support interval
the frozen simulator's priority, lifecycle and admission semantics throughout
deviation: MAX_JOINT_FUTURE=4 plus shortest-directed-path truncation, for exact joint inference within a fixed compute budget
sample_tasks(r) omitted because a node is an indivisible execution unit
the original LLM/regular executor and batching runtime environment are not reproduced; the port targets the unified VideoSeek GPU simulator
narrow_items_closed_before_freeze: topology leakage via the realized template's unexecuted suffix
Range multiplied instead of summed, with a max(1.0, range) floor
pairwise mutual-information sum standing in for the joint
L2 measuring an agreement rate instead of mutual information
stage_range_ms returning 0.0 for an unknown stage
evidence falling back to the template duration instead of an observation
mutual information and Range using different future sets
a ready candidate not conditioned on X != ABSENT
the remaining-duration interval being an expectation rather than a support
the interval covering only a candidate's descendants rather than the whole job
the posterior memo not bound to the network identity
freeze_breaking_exception: A reproducible correctness bug only, recorded as a freeze-breaking fix and never retuned to improve results. By construction the posterior memoization on the profiler is safe only while cpds and stage_order are not mutated in place.

freeze_breaking_fixes.defect: EXPLOIT's remaining-work estimator walked only the candidate's network DESCENDANTS and conditioned every posterior on the completed evidence alone, while EXPLORE and current service condition on X != ABSENT. A stage with no directed path from the candidate was dropped, and the three consumers sat in different information states.
freeze_breaking_fixes.fix: new expected_job_remaining_ms(profiler, evidence, current_stage) sums EVERY unresolved model-side stage with each posterior conditioned on current_stage != ABSENT; job_duration_interval_ms accepts known_present so a ready stage cannot contribute a spurious zero; the dead load term is removed because intrinsic durations already contain cold load. Eq.6 (correlated descendants + top-4) is unchanged.
